independent_solve.reasoning: The inner lining of the small intestine is composed of epithelial tissue, specifically simple columnar epithelium. This specialized tissue features microvilli to increase the surface area for absorption and secretion of digestive enzymes and mucus. While connective, nervous, and muscular tissues are present in the deeper layers of the intestinal wall, the innermost lining itself is made of epithelial tissue.
